Commentary.Commentary: We are back for India's reply! The players stride out to the middle. KL Rahul and Mayank Agarwal are the openers for India. Kagiso Rabada to start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... Third Innings ...

Indian bowling performance was all about Shardul Thakur who got his first five-wicket haul and whenever India was struggling to get the breakthrough he was the one who provided it. All other bowlers were disciplined and the pressure was always kept on from both ends. Shardul Thakur finished with seven wickets and he is the one who has kept India in the game here. It is upto their batters now to gain an upper hand in this Test match they trail by 27 runs which doesn't look threatening. Who will inch ahead at the end of the day? We shall find out. Stay tuned for India's second innings.

South African batters showed resilience out there in the middle on a tricky pitch. Keegan Petersen and Bavuma were especially impressive as they notched up their respective fifties. But despite getting some handy partnerships, the problem of losing wickets in cluster cost South Africa big time. They had a longer tail in this Test match but Jansen and Maharaj had a good partnership in the end and they were eventually bundled out for 229 with crucial lead under their belt.

Shardul Thakur leads the side with a standing ovation. He has been the stand-out bowler for India and ends with figures 7/61- The best ever by an India bowler on South African soil. South Africa lead by 27 runs.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shardul Thakur ends with seven wickets to his name. Hurls in a length ball, outside off. Lungi Ngidi has a feel for it. The ball goes off the outside edge and carries through to the keeper. Rishabh Pant dives to his right to collect the ball. Shardul Thakur has been magnificent and has reaped rewards. SOUTH AFRICA ARE ALL OUT FOR 229. They lead by 27 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, on off. Duanne Olivier drives it back to the bowler. The ball deflects off his hands and rolls back to mid on for a run.
On a length, outside off. Duanne Olivier lets it be.
Lungi Ngidi is the last batter to come in.

OUT! CAUGHT! India needed a wicket and guess who provides the breakthrough, Lord Thakur again! A full ball on middle. Marco Jansen looks to heave it towards the on side. But gets a leading edge. The ball goes high in the air towards extra cover. Ravichandran Ashwin there takes a fine catch. India are just 1 wicket away now and they will be looking to wrap it up quickly now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ravichandran Ashwin b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller, on the pads. Duanne Olivier defends it on the leg side.
Good-length ball, around off, shaping away. Duanne Olivier looks to defend but the ball zips past the outside edge.
Fuller, on off. Duanne Olivier pushes it towards covers.
Length ball, outside off, nipping away. Duanne Olivier looks to play inside the line and misses.

NOT OUT! A length ball on middle and nipping into the batter. Duanne Olivier looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire is unmoved and Shami convinces Rahul to take a review.  The replays roll in there is nothing on UltraEdge. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows wicket's missing. So Duanne Olivier survives and India are still searching for these last two wickets.

India have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows there is no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows the ball is pitching outside off, the impact is around leg and it is wickets missing. The on-field decision stands. India lose a review.
Back of a length, around off. Duanne Olivier shoulders arms.
Another nasty short ball on middle. Jansen ducks under it. Good quality action here.
A good short ball by Bumrah in replay to that boundary. Jansen ducks under it.
FOUR! Another boundary for Jansen! A full ball, on middle. Jansen stays deep in his crease and slams it wide of long on for a boundary. These are crucial runs for South Africa.
A yorker on off. Jansen digs it out. Good bowling this.
A full ball, on off. Jansen makes room and lifts this towards long off. A single is denied again.
FOUR! Jansen is getting some valuable runs for South Africa! A short ball on off. Jansen pulls this time but gets the top edge. The ball flies over Pant and races towards the fence for a boundary.
Jansen takes a risky run to retain the strike! Back of a length, on middle. Jansen works it to mid-wicket for a quick single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single taken.
Back of a length, on off. Jansen defends it back to the bowler. Will he get a single off the last ball?
A full ball, outside off. Jansen goes chasing for it but misses.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Marco Jansen heaves it across the line but misses.
A yorker on off. Jansen jams it out over the bowler's head. The ball goes towards long off and the batters run two.
A full ball, on off. Marco Jansen hits this off the inside half of his blade towards deep square leg. He denies a single.
A fuller delivery on off this time. Duanne Olivier defends it towards the off side.
On a length, on off. Duanne Olivier defends this off the front foot towards the off side.

Duanne Olivier has been hit on the elbow and looks in some pain. The physios are out and are having a check on him. The physios apply some magic spray and he is ready to fight on. We are set to resume.
NASTY! Bangs a short ball, on middle. Duanne Olivier turns away trying to sway away from the line. He gets hit on the elbow.
A length ball angling into middle. Duanne Olivier looks to defend but gets an inside edge of his blade onto the pads. There is a huge appeal from Bumrah but the umpire is unmoved.
Duanne Olivier walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Jasprit Bumrah finally gets his first wicket and breaks this partnership! A full ball angling into the batter by going wide from the crease on middle and off. Keshav Maharaj makes room and looks to drive it but misses. The ball shatters the stumps and Keshav Maharaj walks back after playing a handy knock here. Not much celebration by the Indian players and rightly so as they were frustrated by this partnership. They will be looking to wrap this up quickly now.
Back of a length, on leg. Marco Jansen works it to deep square leg for one.
NO BALL! A beamer this time on off. Marco Jansen deals with it nicely and lets it go. That slipped out of his hands and will have to reload again.

WIDE! Bumrah bowls this short on middle. Keshav Maharaj sways away from the line of the ball but it is anyways too high. Pant jumping to catch the ball fails to collect it cleanly and the batters take a bye. Wide given for height.
Length ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller, on off. Keshav Maharaj drives it but straight to covers.
On a good length, on leg, coming back in. Keshav Maharaj looks to defend but gets hit on the pads.
On a good length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj throws the kitchen sink to this one as well but fails to connect.
FOUR! Top shot! These runs will hurt India! Short of a length, on off. Keshav Maharaj camps back and hammers it towards long on for a boundary.

Length ball, outside off. Keshav Maharaj heaves it towards long on. Mohammed Siraj from mid on traces back but couldn't chase the ball and it falls short of him by quite a distance. Two taken. Shardul Thakur is not happy with that at all.
Full and slower, on the pads. Keshav Maharaj sits down on one knee and looks to sweep. The ball goes off the pads to fine leg for a leg bye.
Fuller, outside off. Marco Jansen steers it to deep backward point for a single.
Short of a length, on off. Keshav Maharaj cuts it to point for a single.
Bangs a short ball once again, on middle and leg. Keshav Maharaj sways away from the line.
Similar line and length, on middle. Keshav Maharaj defends it to the off side.
On a length, on off. Keshav Maharaj does well to defend it out from the crease.
Fuller, on the pads. Marco Jansen flicks it aerially towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. South Africa now lead by 1 run.
Back of a length, on off. Marco Jansen punches it to point.

In the air, but safe! Short of a length, on leg. Marco Jansen looks to pull. The ball goes off his gloves, hits him in the chest region and lobs up towards the leg side. Rishabh Pant charges ahead to catch the ball but falls short of him.
Back of a length, on off. Marco Jansen stays solid in his defence.
On a length, on off. Marco Jansen gets forward and blocks it out.
This is eased down to mid off for a single.

FOUR BYES! South Africa will take these runs however they came. Bumrah bangs a short ball, on middle and leg. Marco Jansen ducks under it. Rishabh Pant tried his best to stop the ball jumping but the ball hits his gloves and rolls back to fine leg for a boundary.
Short ball, on middle, but the ball stays a touch low. Marco Jansen sits under it but gets hit on the shoulder. India appeal for an lbw but the umpire says no.
Fuller and on off, Keshav Maharaj drives it towards covers for a single.
Similar delivery like the previous one. Keshav Maharaj ducks under it.
Bangs a short ball, on leg. Keshav Maharaj sits under it.
Fuller in length, on off. Keshav Maharaj defends it to the off side.
Jasprit Bumrah to start from the other end.
Fuller and on off, Marco Jansen looks to drive. The ball goes off the inner half and knocks the stumps at the other end.

Marco Jansen has been hit on the chest as Shardul Thakur's delivery bounces off sharply from the length. He is looking in some pain here and is getting some treatment now. The young man looks fine now and is all ready to resume.
OUCH! Back of a length, on off. The ball shoots up after landing. Marco Jansen looks to defend. He misses and gets near the chest area. He looks in some pain.
Good-length ball, on top of off, coming back in. Marco Jansen is cut in half as he looks to defend. Good comeback by Shardul Thakur.
FOUR! Poor from Shardul Thakur. Offers width, outside off. Marco Jansen takes the advantage and slashes it through covers for a boundary. The timing on that one was excellent.
Back of a length, on off. Marco Jansen hangs back and blocks it out.
Good-length ball, on middle and leg. Marco Jansen looks to work it on the leg side but gets hit on the thigh pads.
The final session of Day 2 is all set to begin! Indian players sride out to the middle. Marco Jansen and Keshav Maharaj also jog out to resume their innings. Shardul Thakur to start for India.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 …

Session Summary - 25.2 overs, 89 runs, 3 wickets. South Africa were doing really well and it looked like they would enter Lunch unscathed but the dimension of the game changed when Dean Elgar got out and then Shardul Thakur struck twice at the stroke of Lunch to put India in the ascendancy. Two new batters were at the crease post Lunch for the hosts in Temba Bavuma and Kyle Verreynne and they batted beautifully. The duo dealt with some real peaches and scored at a decent clip but Shardul Thakur or as he is called, Lord Shardul Thakur once again got the breakthrough removing Kyle Verreynne. While Bavuma continued on his merry way and brought up his half century but departed immediately. The tail was exposed then and India need just 3 wickets before they come out to bat again. While South Africa would look to add some vital runs and have a decent lead over India. Join us for the final session at 6.30 pm IST (1 pm GMT).
Shardul Thakur leads the side as he has picked up his maiden five-wicket haul in Tests. Just like the first session, India have again comeback with a strong reply in the last hour of this session.

Shami goes for a yorker on the last ball before Tea. It is very full on middle and Jansen flicks it to deep square leg for a single. So South Africa are 191/7 at Tea on Day 2 and are still trailing by 11 runs.
On a length and nipping away around off. Keshav Maharaj pokes at it and gets a thick outside edge to point for a single.
Shami bowls a short ball on middle in reply to that boundary. Keshav Maharaj ducks under it and Pant behind the stumps does well to catch that.
FOUR! What a good shot this is! Back of a length, on off. Keshav Maharaj punches this off the back foot through covers for a lovely boundary. This guy can bat for sure.
A good-length delivery on off. Keshav Maharaj plants his front foot forward and defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length, on off. Keshav Maharaj defends it solidly towards the off side.
A length ball, outside off. Jansen lets it go this time.
A fuller ball on middle this time. Jansen flicks it to mid-wicket this time.
On a length, on off. Some extra bounce there and Keshav Maharaj dabs it square on the on side for a single.
FOUR! A short ball and punished by Maharaj! A short ball on off and comfortable height for Maharaj to pull. He pulls it through square leg for a boundary. Lovely shot!
Another length ball, on off. Keshav Maharaj blocks it towards the off side.
A length ball, on off. Maharaj defends it towards the off side this time.
A full ball, on off. Pushed to covers for a single this time.
A good-length delivery outside off. Keshav Maharaj looks to push at it but gets beaten. Superb bowling.
Maharaj is greeted with a short ball on middle. Keshav Maharaj ducks under it.
Keshav Maharaj walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and India are chipping in with some quick wickets here! Shami bowls this full on off again. Rabada goes for that expansive drive. The ball hits the inside half of his blade and loops in the air towards mid on. Siraj there takes an easy catch and South Africa are seven down now. Shami knew that Rabada is not going to resist the drive and he gets his man with that fuller delivery. Kagiso Rabada will be disappointed as he has the ability to bat but is gone now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammed Siraj b Mohammed Shami

Commentary.Commentary: Another full ball and this time Rabada drives it to covers crisply but Rahane stops it at covers.
Shami bowls a full ball on off. Rabada looks to drive but fails to get the timing on that one.
A fuller length delivery outside off. Jansen leaves it alone.
NO BALL! Back of a length on middle and leg. Rabada looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits him high on the pads and a leg bye is taken towards the on side. Thakur has overstepped here.
A good-length delivery around off. Rabada pushes this off the front foot square on the off side.
A length ball, on off. Rabada leans forward and defends it towards the on side.

Not sure what the hoohah is about as the third umpire is checking the catch if it taken cleanly. It was taken clean as a whistle and Temba Bavuma now starts walking off the field as the third umpire confirms it is OUT. Kagiso Rabada walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shardul Thakur gets the first five-wicket haul of his Test career! What an occasion to get to your maiden five-wicket haul. Temba Bavuma walks down the track for some strange reason and Thakur pulls his length back around leg. Bavuma looks to clip it and gets a faint part of his blade. Pant behind the stumps dives to his left and takes a superb catch. Bavuma who was looking so good has to walk back and India are right on top now. There was some confusion regrading the catch taken by Pant but in the end replays show that he has taken it cleanly and Thakur is on a roll here.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Edge but safe and Bavuma gets to his fifty with a boundary! A good-length ball, around off. Bavuma looks to drive it and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards the third slip region for a boundary. This has been a fine knock from him.
A full ball, on off. Jansen drives this off the outer half of his blade to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Bavuma goes big! Ashwin bowls short, on middle. Temba Bavuma hangs back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Real intent from Temba Bavuma who is looking for his half century.
Full and on the pads, tucked to short leg.
Floats it up, on middle. Clipped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That's a good shot! He moves into 40's now. Tossed up, on the pads. Temba Bavuma clears his front leg and works it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on middle. Temba Bavuma works it to the leg side.
Full and on middle, Temba Bavuma steps out and clips it on the leg side.
Marco Jansen is the new batsman in.

South Africa have taken a review for an LBW. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that it is pitching outside off, impact is in line and it is wickets hitting. The originl decision stands and India retain their review.

OUT! LBW! Lord Thakur strikes again! A good-length delivery on off and that nips back in sharply. Kyle Verreynne is stuck on his crease as he tries to defend it. He misses and the ball hits him on the pads. There is a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger.  Kyle Verreynne reviews it but the Ball Tracker shows THREE REDS and Kyle Verreynne has to walk back. A big wicket for India as this partnership was building up and it is Shardul Thakur once again who provides the breakthrough. South Africa have lost half of their side now and India will be looking to quickly wrap this up now.
Another harmless delivery on a length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne leaves it alone.
Back of a length, around off. Kyle Verreynne pushes this off the back foot towards covers this time.
A good-length delivery outside off. Kyle Verreynne decides to leave it alone this time.
Back of a length again, around off. Kyle Verreynne looks to cut but is unable to get any timing.
Back of a length, outside off. Bavuma cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker on off. Kyle Verreynne blocks this off the back foot.
A fuller ball and flatter on middle. Kyle Verreynne skips down the track and somehow manages to defend it.
On middle and leg and turning into the batter. Kyle Verreynne looks to defend but gets the inside edge onto his pads. The ball loops in the air towards the on side.
On middle and leg again. Bavuma flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Again on the leg stump. Kyle Verreynne gets back and works it behind square on the on side for a single.
Fuller on middle. Worked towards mid-wicket this time.
Back of a length with some extra bounce on off. Bavuma looks to defend but gets hit on his gloves.
Thakur hits the length hard again.  It is on the off stump line and Bavuma defends this off the back foot.
A good-length delivery outside off. Bavuma leaves it alone this time.
Thakur goes fuller on middle this time. Bavuma drives it off the inside half of his blade towards deep square leg for a couple.
On a length this time with an inward movement. Bavuma leaves it alone.
FOUR! Bavuma gets another boundary. He is looking class apart here! A short ball, outside off. Bavuma quickly picks the length and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Slower through the air, outside off. Kyle Verreynne lunges forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Kyle Verreynne prods and pushes it to mid on.
Full and on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle. Bavuma pushes this to long on as he skips down the track and gets a single.
A fuller ball on leg. Kyle Verreynne skips down the track and  clips it to fine leg for a single. 50-run stand comes up between these two.
Shorter length on off. Kyle Verreynne cuts it to point.
Back of a length, outside off. Bavuma leaves it alone.
On a length and this one bounces a little low on off. Bavuma defends this off the bottom of his blade.

FOUR! Bavuma has looked very comfortable so far and he has played a glorious shot now! An overpitched ball on middle. Bavuma drives it with full face of his blade and creams it through mid on for a boundary. Superb timing.
On a length and nipping into middle. Bavuma works it to square leg.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma defends this off the back foot back to the bowler.
This is intense from Bumrah! A good-length delivery outside off. Bavuma pushes it to point this time.
Another flatter delivery by Ashwin on middle. Kyle Verreynne defends this off the back foot.
Flatter and shorter in length on middle. Kyle Verreynne clips it straight to short leg again.
Quicker on middle. Defended towards the on side this time.
Shorter length this time on off. Worked towards the short leg fielder.
A fuller ball, on off. Bavuma skips down the track and clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off from 'round the wicket. Bavuma defends this off the front foot.
On a length again and angling into middle. Kyle Verreynne defends it to mid-wicket this time.
On a length and nipping back in from off. Kyle Verreynne defends it onto the turf.
On a length, on middle. Kyle Verreynne clips it to mid-wicket this time. Bumrah is looking for that LBW.
Bumrah bowls this on off and fuller again. Bavuma pushes it to mid off and gets a single.
A fulll ball and down the leg side this time. Bavuma looks to flick it but misses.
A good-length delivery outside off. Bavuma looks to defend but the ball seams away from him and beats the outside edge of his blade.

Drinks! Once again, the opening hour after the break has belonged to South Africa. It looked like it won't take long for India to end South Africa's innings but Kyle Verreynne and Temba Bavuma are building along a nice partnership. Can India claw their way back just like they did in the morning session? An interesting hour of play coming up...
Well bowled and well played! Tossed up, on off. Kyle Verreynne looks to defend. He plays it with soft hands though and the ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a brace.
This is eased to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller ball on off. Bavuma pushes this back to the bowler. Ashwin needs to bowl little slower to get more purchase from the pitch.
A fuller ball on middle. Bavuma skips down the track and flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Ashwin goes fuller on off this time. Bavuma defends this off the front foot this time.
Shorter length around off. Bavuma pushes this off the back foot towards covers.
Bumrah goes fuller on middle this time. Kyle Verreynne defends it towards mid on. He is not getting a big stride in and could be a candidate for LBW.
A short ball and around leg this time. Kyle Verreynne ducks under it comfortably again.
Back of a length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne leaves it alone this time.
WIDE! Short ball on middle and it goes well over the batter's head. A wide called for height as Kyle Verreynne ducks under it.
Bumrah bowls this fuller around off. Kyle Verreynne pushes it off the front foot to covers and gets a couple.
Full and down the leg side this time. Kyle Verreynne looks to flick it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Kyle Verreynne defends it tentatively towards the off side.
FOUR! Bavuma has found the gap this time! A length ball angling into middle and leg. Bavuma leans forwarda and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A fuller ball on middle. Bavuma pushes it to mid on this time.
A good-length delivery around off and nips back in sharply. Bavuma leaves it watchfully.
A fuller ball, on middle. Bavuma drives it to mid on this time.
This one comes back in a little from the off stump line, off the length. Bavuma defends it again towards the on side.
Siraj bowls this on a length, on middle. Bavuma defends it to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off, coming back in. Kyle Verreynne stands up on his toes and defends it on the leg side.
Full again, outside off this time. Kyle Verreynne drives it to short extra cover.
Goes full, on middle. Kyle Verreynne gets his feet out of the way and pushes it to mid on.
Short of a length, on off. Kyle Verreynne hops and blocks it from the crease.
On a length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne defends it out.
Back of a length, around off, moving away. Kyle Verreynne looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Jasprit Bumrah (13-4-26-0) is back into the attack.
On a length, on leg. Kyle Verreynne clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fuller, on middle. Kyle Verreynne squeezes it out to backward square leg.
Angling in a length ball, on middle and leg. Kyle Verreynne prods and looks to flick. He misses and gets struck on the pads. Jasprit Bumrah appeals for an lbw but that was going down leg.
On middle and leg, defended to short mid-wicket.
On a good length, around off. Kyle Verreynne presses forward and blocks it out.
Back of a length, on middle. Temba Bavuma hops and tucks it on the leg side for a single.
Mohammed Siraj (7.5-2-18-0) is back into the attack.
Short ball, on middle. Kyle Verreynne ducks under it.
Length ball, outside off. Kyle Verreynne jabs it to mid off.
On a length, down leg. Kyle Verreynne looks to flick but misses. Rishabh Pant dives to his left to collect the ball. India appeal for a caught behind but there was nothing on it.
In the channel again, outside off. Kyle Verreynne offers no shot.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone.

Good-length ball, on off, coming back in. Temba Bavuma gets forward and looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Shardul Thakur appeals for an lbw but there was a clear inside edge there. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters take a single.
Ohh..What a delivery to end the over! A good-length delivery around off. Nips back in sharply and cuts Kyle Verreynne into half. Beats him all ends up and goes back to the keeper.
Back of a length, on off. Kyle Verreynne defends it towards the off side off the back foot.
A good short ball by Shami on middle this time. Kyle Verreynne ducks under it.

NOT OUT! Kyle Verreynne survives. Length ball, coming back in, on middle. Kyle Verreynne looks to work it on the leg side but gets an insidee edge onto the pads. Mohammed Shami appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no. India opt for a review. UltraEdge shows there is a spike as the ball passes the bat. The original decision stands and India lose their review. India thought they had their man but will have to wait now.

Review! India have reviewed for an LBW against Kyle Verreynne! The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that there is a huge spike as it passes the blade. So Kyle Verreynne survives. It looked dead straight to the naked eye but the inside edge saves him. The decision stays as NOT OUT!
Good-length ball, around off. Temba Bavuma taps it to the off side for a single.
Short and down the leg side. Temba Bavuma sways away from the line.
On a good length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne shoulders arms.
On a length, outside off. Left alone.

FOUR! Another boundary! Kyle Verreynne is looking in good touch. Promising start for the wicket-keeper batsman who came in place of Quinton de Kock. Length ball, outside off. Kyle Verreynne drives it through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Bangs a bouncer, on off. Kyle Verreynne sits under it. Wide called for height.
FOUR! Shot! Short of a length, on middle. Kyle Verreynne pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne shoulders arms.
Touch fuller, outside off. Temba Bavuma drives it towards covers. The fielder there does well to dive to his right and half stop it. Saves three runs for his side.
A yorker this time by Shami on middle. Kyle Verreynne digs it out. This is brilliant stuff from Shami. After bowling two good short balls, he delivers a perfect yorker this time.

Another delivery that is targeted into the body and is at an awkward height for Kyle Verreynne to defend. He hops and looks to defend. The ball hits his gloves and goes off the bounce to Pant behind the stumps.
Sharp bouncer from Shami angling into the body this time. Bavuma plays it awkwardly towards fine leg for a single.

FOUR! A thick outside edge again and a boundary this time! A good-length delivery outside off. Bavuma drives it on up and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies past the diving gully fielder and goes for a boundary.
Shami bowls this on middle this time. Kyle Verreynne clips it to fine leg for a single this time.
Good-length delivery outside off. Kyle Verreynne leaves it comfortably.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma defends this off the back foot towards the off side.
A good-length delivery outside off. Bavuma pushes this off the front foot and gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes towards the backward point region and the batters run two.
A length ball, around off. The ball hits the green patch and bounces sharply. Kyle Verreynne defends it and it goes off the top of his blade. A single taken towards square leg.
A fuller delivery on off by Thakur. Kyle Verreynne defends it towards mid on this time. There is certainly some swing out there for both the bowlers.
Back of a length, on off. Kyle Verreynne defends it solidly off the back foot.
Another good ball by Thakur! A good-length delivery on middle that nips away from the batter. Kyle Verreynne defends it with the outer half of his blade.
A full ball with a hint of away swing on off. Bavuma drives it off the middle of his blade straight to the short-cover fielder.
This one nips back in from middle off the length. Bavuma clips it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma blocks this off the back foot.
Shami goes fuller outside off this time. Bavuma plants his front foot forward and drives it past mid off for a couple.
Back of a length, on off. Kyle Verreynne works it to fine leg for a single.
Short ball this time on off. Kyle Verreynne ducks under it.
Back of  a length, outside off. Kyle Verreynne punches this off the back foot through backward point. The batters run three before the fielder cuts it off.
Thakur pulls his length back again and bowls this outside off. Kyle Verreynne lets it go.
Thakur goes fuller this time on off. Kyle Verreynne drives it to mid off.
Back of a length, this time on off. Kyle Verreynne blocks this off the back foot towards the off side.
Another good-length delivery outside off. Kyle Verreynne leaves it alone again as Thakur is right on the target again.
A good-length delivery outside off. Kyle Verreynne leaves it alone.
A good-length delivery outside off. Bavuma leaves it alone as it seams away.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma defends this off the back foot towards the on side.
Full ball, on off from Shami with a hint of away shape. Bavuma drives and gets the outer half of his blade. The ball goes towards covers and the batters take two runs.
On a length and down the leg side this time. Bavuma looks to flick it but misses.
Back of a length, on off. Extra bounce for Shami as Bavuma blocks it.
Shami bowls this on a good length outside off. Bavuma lets it go.
A good-length delivery outside off. Kyle Verreynne leaves it alone. Thakur completes his successful over. A wicket-maiden!
Thakur bowls this back of a length, on off. Kyle Verreynne blocks this off the back foot.

We are back for the middle session! The players stride out to the middle. Temba Bavuma walks out alongside Kyle Verreynne. Shardul Thakur to complete his over. We are hearing that Rassie van der Dussen's catch wasn't conclusive enough for the third umpire to give NOT OUT. So, Rassie van der Dussen is not coming back.
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

Indian bowlers were top-notch this morning but some quality batting by South Africa denied them a breakthrough for the most part of the session. It was the man with the golden arm, Shardul Thakur who eventually got the wicket of South African skipper, Dean Elgar. After his wicket, the pair of Petersen and Rassie van der Dussen were tasted with some quality seam bowling and Shardul Thakur again got into the act with the wickets of Keegan Petersen and Rassie van der Dussen. India have got three wickets in the final half-hour of the first session and will be now looking to dictate terms. Can India continue their fightback with more wickets in the next session? We shall find out as we will be back for the post-lunch session at 4.10 pm IST (10.40 am GMT).

Another session, that looked like going South Africa’s way was pulled back by India with three wickets in the last half hour of the session. In testing conditions where the ball was seaming and swinging quite a bit, South Africa  batted solidly at the start. Both Elgar and Keegan Petersen were solid this morning and despite some quality bowling by Indian bowlers, the pair ensured that India were denied the breakthrough for the major part of the session. Elgar departed just half an hour before Lunch but young Keegan Petersen carried on and got to his maiden Test fifty. But the wickets of Keegan Petersen and Rassie van der Dussen just at the stroke of the Lunch has ensured that India have an opening now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Things are falling apart for South Africa now. Shardul Thakur has struck not once, not twice, but thrice for India and has put his side back in the game. Back of a length, outside off, coming into the batter. Rassie van der Dussen is caught on the crease as he tries to defend. The ball goes off the inside edge, hits him on the pads and carries through to Rishabh Pant who dives ahead to grab the ball. Shardul Thakur appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Well, well, well, the replay shows that the ball hit the grass before Rishabh Pant caught it but Rassie van der Dussen started walking to the pavilion. So the decision stands. South Africa have been reduced to 102/4 in no time. Shardul Thakur has picked up three wickets in a span of 4.5 overs. Top stuff from the man with the golden arm. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, down leg. Rassie van der Dussen is not troubled by that line.
Fuller and on off, Rassie van der Dussen presses forward and blocks.
Outside off, on a length. Rassie van der Dussen lets it sail through.
Length ball, coming back in, on middle. Temba Bavuma gets forward and pushes it to mid on.
Fuller in length, on middle. Temba Bavuma pushes it to mid off.
Short again, on leg. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to fine leg for a single.

Brilliant stuff from Mohammed Shami! Make them smell the leather says Sunil Gavaskar on air. Short of a length, on off. The ball shoots up after pitching. Rassie van der Dussen looks to play at it initially but decides not to in the end.
Bangs a short ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen sways away from the line.
Full and on off, Rassie van der Dussen digs it back to the bowler.
Temba Bavuma is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Keegan Petersen was leaving the balls that were outside off but now that he has got his half century, he decides to drive this one and pays the price. Thakur bowls this one on a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen reaches out for it and tries to drive it on the up. The ball nips away a tad and kisses the outside edge. It flies to Mayank Agarwal at second slip and he takes a sharp catch. Keegan Petersen got a bit carried away and now has to depart after playing a good knock. Shardul Thakur has struck once again for India and South Africa lose their third wicket before Lunch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mayank Agarwal b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs a short ball, on middle. Keegan Petersen ducks under it.
Fuller in length, on off. Keegan Petersen guides it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, outside off, shaping away. Keegan Petersen leaves it alone.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
This is played on the off side by KP.
Outside off, left alone.

Review! Rassie van der Dussen has been given OUT here, CAUGHT BEHIND! Rassie van der Dussen has reviewed it. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows that the ball has hit his pads and there is no bat involved. So the decision will be overturned and Rassie van der Dussen survives.

NOT OUT! Huge appeal for a caught behind and the umpire gave it out. Length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen is very late on his defense. He plays it with his bat and pad very close. The ball goes behind and India are very confident that it came off the outside edge and even the umpire felt the same. Rassie van der Dussen though reviews it. UltraEdge shows that it came off the back pad instead. The on-field decision is overturned and South Africa retain their review. Replay also shows that the ball bounced in front of Rishabh Pant before he grabbed it.
Fuller, on middle. Keegan Petersen flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off. Keegan Petersen taps it to the off side.
On a good length again, around off, nipping away. Keegan Petersen prods and looks to defend with a straight bat. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Keegan Petersen looks to push. The ball zips past his outside edge. Keegan Petersen is lucky that he didn't get a nick there.
Another one left alone by Rassie van der Dussen as this was well outside off.
Outside off. Rassie van der Dussen offers no shot to that one as he continues his leaving spree.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen hops and defends it to the off side.
Ohhh! That's a beauty! On a good length, around off, nipping away. Rassie van der Dussen covers his stumps and shouders arms. The ball was whisker away from hitting the off stump there.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
On a length, outside off, moving away. Rassie van der Dussen lets it sail through.
Shami bowls this full on middle. Pushed to mid on this time.
A fuller ball again, on off. Keegan Petersen looks to drive but gets the inside edge of his blade towards the on side.

FOUR! He is dealing in boundaries at the moment! An overpitched delivery on off. Keegan Petersen drives it through covers for a beautiful boundary again. The balance he has while playing that shot is amazing. 100 comes up for South Africa as well.
A length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen blocks it back to the bowler this time.
FOUR! Another boundary! A fuller delivery on middle this time. Keegan Petersen flicks it through the square leg region for a boundary. Shot from a man in confidence.

FOUR! Keegan Petersen gets to his maiden Test match fifty with a boundary! A fuller delivery from Shami on off. Keegan Petersen looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge, The ball goes through the backward point region for a boundary. Top class innings this by Keegan Petersen.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping away. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shardul Thakur strikes and this man has the knack of picking important wickets and he has done it again. He is a man with the golden arm and he has proved it yet again. A good-length delivery around off. Elgar is forced to play at that one and he does. The ball seams away sharply and catches the outside edge of his blade. It goes back to Pant behind the stumps and he takes an easy catch. A big, big wicket for India and Dean Elgar was the one man who can bat deep in these conditions. Shardul Thakur has delivered again for his team and India have got the first breakthrough they were searching for. Dean Elgar walks back to the pavilion after a hard-fought 28 off 120 balls. Shardul Thakur has broken this partnership and India have got the opening now.
Commentary.Howout: c Rishabh Pant b Shardul Thakur

Back of a length again, around off this time. Elgar pushes it to cover-point.
Back of a length by Thakur again on off. Elgar defends it solidly back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes this off the back foot through the gap between mid off and covers. Shami cuts it off just inside the fence and the batters run three.
Ashwin drifts on the pads this time. Keegan Petersen clips it to fine leg for a single.
Fuller length again by Ashwin. Elgar drives it to covers for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Elgar defends it off the front foot this time.
FOUR! Nicely timed by Elgar! A full ball, on off. Elgar pushes it towards mid on with beautiful timing for a boundary.
A fuller ball, on off. Elgar pushes it to covers this time.
A fuller ball, on middle. Worked to mid-wicket this time.
Back of a length, on middle. Worked square on the on side for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Defended watchfully by Elgar.

Drinks! Dean Elgar and Keegan Petersen have done really well to battle out the first hour of this session. They are moving along at a slow pace but that won't matter to South Africa as these two are still on the crease. India will need to pull out something off their arsenal and will look to chip in with a few wickets before Lunch.

Tossed up, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.

Length ball, on middle. Keegan Petersen pushes it to mid on.
Fuller, outside off. Keegan Petersen drives it towards covers.

Fuller and outside off. Driven towards extra cover.
On a good length, on off. Keegan Petersen covers the line and blocks it out watchfully.

On a length, outside off. Left alone by Petersen.
On a good length, on middle, coming back in. Keegan Petersen looks to play it across the line and gets hit on the thigh pad.

NOT OUT! Fuller in length, outside off. Dean Elgar looks to drive but gets an outside edge. The ball bumps on the ground and then carries through to the keeper. But the ball bumped and then went into the gloves of Rishabh Pant. The soft signal is overturned and Dean Elgar survives.

There is an appeal for a caught behind! The umpires are checking for the bump ball. So they have gone upstairs. The soft-signal is OUT! The replays roll in and the Ultra Edge shows that there is bat involved but then the ball bumped on the ground. So Elgar survives and India are still searching for their first wicket of the morning.
On a length, on middle, angling in. Dean Elgar stays solid in his defence.
Fuller in length, on off. Dean Elgar pushes it past the bowler to silly mid off.

On a length, on off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out.

Good-length delivery outside off. Dean Elgar leaves it alone.
Another delivery on off. Elgar is solid in his defence again.
A good-length delivery outside off this time. Elgar lets it go.
A fuller delivery on off. Keegan Petersen drives it through covers and the batters run three. Good running there as boundaries are hard to come by.
On a good-length on off. Keegan Petersen defends it towards the off side. Both the bowlers are giving nothing away.
Shami goes fuller on off this time. Elgar defends it off the front foot towards the off side.
A good-length delivery outside off. Elgar leaves it alone this time.
Back of a length and getting good bounce this time. Elgar hops and defends it onto the turf and almost chops it onto the stumps.
Back of a length and down the leg side. Elgar looks to clip it but misses.

Shami targets middle stump this time. Keegan Petersen flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length with some extra bounce and seams away from off. Keegan Petersen defends it to point this time.
A length ball on middle this time by Shami. Keegan Petersen works it to square leg this time.
Shami bowls this on a good length around off. The ball seams away from Keegan Petersen as he leaves it alone.
On a good length, outside off. Left alone by Elgar.
Good-length ball, on off. Dean Elgar stands up on his toes and blocks it out.
Goes full now, on off. Elgar flicks it to mid-wicket.
Comes 'round the wicket now for Dean Elgar. Back of a length, outside off. Dean Elgar has a slash at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Cracked away! Back of a length, on off, coming back in. Keegan Petersen hops and punches it through covers. The batters run three before the cover fielder cuts it off. Positive start from Petersen.
Fuller in length, on off. Keegan Petersen presses forward and defends it out.
Jasprit Bumrah to start from the other end.

Much better from Shami! Bowls this one closer to the stumps. Good-length ball, in the fourth stump channel, nipping away. Dean Elgar looks to defend but withdraws his bat at the last moment. It sails past him and carries through to the keeper.
Outside off, on a length. Dean Elgar watches the ball closely and makes a leave.
Back of a length, on middle, angling in. Dean Elgar hops and defends it on the leg side.
Good-length delivery, outside off, nipping away. Dean Elgar lets it sail through.

We are all set to begin! Indian players are in huddle and one can see Siraj there too. So good news for India and they will be itching to get early wickets this morning. Dean Elgar and Keegan Petersen also jog out to the middle to resume their innings. Mohammed Shami to start with the ball for India. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Mike Haysman says that the track is very inconsistent and might be worrisome for the batters. Mentions that there are good areas for bowlers to exploit and says that there is a mix of dead and live grass. Tells that the bounce will be variable and there will be movement off the surface. Informs that it rained overnight and the pitch might quicken up. Ends by saying that it is a tough batting wicket.

Ravichandran Ashwin is down for a chat, he says that when he was batting, he took the scoring opportunites and was aware all the time. Tells that Centurion pitch quickened up later but the bounce at Johannesburg is steep and the pitch might get faster as the day progreses. Tells that it is similar to being a fast bowler in India, you have to get used to the conditions and bowl acording to the plans. On Siraj, he says that he will definitely be okay and hopes that he comes out strong and gives his best. Says that they have a wonderful bowling attack and they will look to give their 100 percent and is sure that they can do the job for the team.

Mohammed Siraj bowled an excellent spell on Day 1 before he pulled his hamstring and left the field. It would be interesting to see if he is fit enough to bowl as India need him desperately as the pitch is favouring the pacers and he can be very lethal alongside Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Shami and Shardul Thakur.

After bundling out India for just 202, South Africa finished Day 1 with 35-1 where they lost the solitary wicket of Aiden Markram. They still trail by 167 runs and they would hope to cut off the deficit and take a lead over India. On the other hand, India need wickets and need them at a quick pace. The pitch is also expected to get faster and the Indian bowlers will be raring to go. All this is only possible if the weather is favourable for play.

Hello and welcome to Day 2 of the Test match. First things first, it is bright and sunny as of now but there is rain predicted for the second and third session. Still, a lot of time for a result though in this game. So let’s now see what the two teams will be looking to do today.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 …

Right then, this has been an engrossing day of Test cricket and South Africa seem to be slightly ahead at the end of the day. But India have enough arsenal in their kitty to comeback strongly on Day 2. They just need to remind themselves what happened the last time they played South Africa here in a Test match. In 2018, India were bowled out for 187 in the first innings but responded strongly by dismissing the Proteas for 194. That too, from a strong position of 80/2. Monday may not have been India's best but Tuesday will be a new day. The first ball will be bowled at 1.30 pm IST (8.00 am GMT) but as you know, the buildup will begin well in advance. So do join us early to catch all the action. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Earlier in the day, it was South Africa who dominated the proceedings as they bundled out India for 202 in the first innings. KL Rahul and Ravichandran Ashwin were the only batters who played a worthy knock as others failed to get going. The pitch assisted the South African bowlers and they kept picking wickets at regular intervals. Marco Jansen ended with 4 wickets while Kagiso Rabada and Duanne Olivier ended with 3 each to their name. It is upto the South African batters now to back up their bowlers and put Indians under pressure on Day 2. India, on the other hand, need to keep believing and some early wickets on Day 2 will bring them right back into the game. A crucial second day of this Test match is awaiting us. Can Indian bowlers fight back? Or will South African batters take their team further ahead in this game? Only time will tell.

Indian bowlers bowled with good steam out there after they were bundled out for 202. Shami provided the early breakthrough as he dismissed Aiden Markram for the third time in this series. All other bowlers bowled well but they failed to get another breakthrough. They will be looking to get some early wickets on Day 2 and would be hoping that Siraj who walked off the field at the stroke of Stumps due to a hamstring issue is fit and raring to go tomorrow as he bowled probing line and lengths and troubled Dean Elgar a lot.

The pair of Dean Elgar and Keegan Petersen have done well here to take their team to the end of the play with just one wicket down. The pitch has enough help for the bowlers but this pair has been quite solid. Aiden Markram departed early yet again and South African batters have a tough task ahead of them but this has been a good day for South Africa and they will be looking to build on it on Day 2.
Fuller in length, outside off. Keegan Petersen reaches out for it and looks to drive. The ball goes off the bottom edge and rolls back to the keeper. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 1!
Full and outside off. Keegan Petersen lets it sail through.
Good-length ball, angling in, on middle and leg. Tucked on the leg side.
On a good length, outside off. Keegan Petersen shoulders arms.
Back of a length, outside off. Left alone by KP.
Length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen presses forward and pushes it to mid on.
Good-length ball, on off, moving away. Dean Elgar does well to defend it out.

Siraj seems to have pulled his hamstring as he was loading to bowl. The physio is out and Siraj is walking back to the pavilion. This is not good news for India and hopefully he will be alright and ready to bowl tomorrow. Shardul Thakur to complete his over.
Short ball, on off. Dean Elgar lets it through. He is not going to fall for these tactics. He is much of an experienced player for that.
Back of a length, on middle. Dean Elgar hops and defends it out.
On a good length, on middle. Dean Elgar gets forward and defends it to the off side.
On a length, on off. Dean Elgar taps it to point.
Length ball, on leg. Dean Elgar looks to flick but misses. The ball misses the leg stump by a whisker. Mohammed Siraj has his hands on his head. He knows that was very close.
Length ball, on off. Good solid stuff from Petersen. Defends this one watchfully.
Back of a length again, outside off. Tapped towards point.
Back of a length, on off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out.
On a length, on off. Keegan Petersen looks to defend. The ball goes off the inside edge to square leg.
Fuller and on off. Keegan Petersen is very solid in his defence.
Back of a length, on middle. Keegan Petersen defends it out.

Dean Elgar is shaking his head! This is bowling of the highest quality by Mohammed Siraj. Full and outside off, Dean Elgar feels for it but gets beaten on the outside edge. Another maiden over for Mohammed Siraj.
Back of a length, outside off, nipping away. Dean Elgar tries to play this one but the angle of the ball sees it sail past the outside edge. Really tesing time this!
On the stumps, the ball keeps a little low. Dean Elgar  manages to get his bat down in time.
This is pushed to mid on.
And again! Length ball, outside off, angling away. Dean Elgar looks to defend but once again the ball zips past the outside edge. Excitement from Indian players.
Length ball, around off, shaping away. Dean Elgar looks to drive but misses. The ball goes past the outside edge.
Back of a length, on off. Keegan Petersen solidly defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length and nipping into the batter this time. Keegan Petersen looks to clip it but misses. He gets hit high on the pads but no damage done.
Back of a length again from Bumrah. Keegan Petersen solidly defends it.
Short of a length, around off. Keegan Petersen taps it to point.

DROPPED! This is the catch that should have been taken by Pant! Short and wide outside off. Keegan Petersen goes for a big cut shot but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies towards first slip and Pant diving to his right drops it. He tried to take it one-handed but the ball didn't stuck to his gloves. It rolled behind him and the batters took two runs.
Back of a length, on off and there is a sharp bounce this time. Keegan Petersen defends it awkwardly towards the on side.
Jasprit Bumrah (5-1-12-0) comes back into the attack.
Short and wide outside off. Elgar slashes at it hard but misses. Elgar is annoyed with himself.
Siraj goes fuller this time on off. Elgar defends it towards the off side. This is a better length from Siraj.
Back of a length on middle. Elgar blocks it onto the turf this time.
A good-length delivery outside off. Elgar leaves it alone this time.
FOUR! Good shot by Elgar! A good short ball on off. Elgar gets right on top of it and pulls it towards backward square leg for a boundary. This is good batting from the South African skipper.
Back of a length, around off. Elgar punches it straight to point this time.
Short of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Keegan Petersen drives it towards the cover region.
On a length, on off. Elgar punches it towards covers for a quick single.
Short of a length, outside off. Dean Elgar lets it through.
Length ball, on off. Dean Elgar defends it back to the bowler.

Shami bowls this on a good length and beats Elgar here! A good-length delivery around off and angling in from 'round the wicket. Elgar looks to defend it but the ball seams away a little and beats the outside edge of his blade.
Good-length ball, on middle. Keegan Petersen hops and defends it to the leg side.
Touch fuller, on off. Keegan Petersen covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
On a good length, outside off. Keegan Petersen punches it to the off side but not in the gap.
On a good length, outside off. Keegan Petersen blocks it from the crease.
Length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen stays solid in his defence.
Mohammed Siraj is into the attack now.
Siraj starts with a length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen watches it go past him.
Good-length ball, outside off. Dean Elgar presses forward and defends it off the inner half to the leg side.
Fuller, outside off. Dean Elgar lifts his bat and lets it go.

Was there an edge there? Good-length ball, around off, coming back in. Dean Elgar looks to defend but the ball zips past the outside edge. Rishabh Pant and the slip corridor was very excited and put up an appeal for caught behind. However, Mohammed Shami was not interested at all. Replay shows that there was no bat involved there.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
On a good length, around off. Dean Elgar leans to defend. This one bounces a little more and it goes off the shoulder of the bat to backward point.
Length ball, on off. Keegan Petersen pushes it through covers for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Dean Elgar stands on his toes and blocks it to the off side.
On a good length, outside off. Dean Elgar leaves it alone.
WIDE! Bangs a bouncer now, on middle. Dean Elgar sits under it. Wide called for height.
On a length, on off. Dean Elgar defends it out.
Good-length ball, outside off, shaping away. Dean Elgar lets it through.
Length ball, on middle. Dean Elgar gets behind the line and knocks it back to the bowler.
On a good length, on leg. Dean Elgar looks to clip but gets struck on the thigh pads and the ball bounces just in front of the short leg fielder.
Length ball, going down leg. Keegan Petersen looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Just a mere push! Fuller, on middle. Keegan Petersen pushes it through mid on for a boundary. Nice presentation of the bat there and gets the desired result.
Back of a length again, on middle. Keegan Petersen with a solid defence.
Back of a length, on off. Keegan Petersen taps it to the off side.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Good-length ball, around off, nipping away. Keegan Petersen looks to defend with soft hands. The ball goes off the outside edge and races away through gully towards third man for a boundary.
On a good length, around off. Dean Elgar lets it sail through.
Good-length ball, on middle, coming back in. Dean Elgar stays solid in his defence.
On a good length, on off. Dean Elgar hops and defends it back to the bowler.
Nicely played! In the gap! Length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen plays it with soft hands through backward point and gets three runs.
Length ball, outside off. Keegan Petersen covers the line and taps it to the off side.
Length ball, around off. Keegan Petersen blocks it out.
Length ball, outside off. Dean Elgar stays back and defends it to the off side. Excellent over from Shami.
On a good length again, on middle, coming back in. Dean Elgar is again cut in half and gets an inside edge onto the pads. Testing over this!

On a good length, outside off, coming back in. Dean Elgar looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge. The 'round the wicket angle is really working for Mohammed Shami here. He is asking the right questions to Elgar.
On a good length, on off, coming back in. Dean Elgar defends it to the off side.

Beauty from Shami! He is all charged up after that wicket. Good-length ball, outside off, jagging back in a long way. Dean Elgar is cut in half as he tries to defend. The ball beats his inside edge and carries through to the keeper.
Good-length ball, outside off, Dean Elgar offers no shot to that one.
A good-length delivery outside off. Keegan Petersen leaves it alone this time.

A bit of edge there saves Keegan Petersen! A full ball on middle by Bumrah. Keegan Petersen looks to clip it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The fielders in the slip corridor were excited as they appealed for LBW but Bumrah knew that there was an edge there.
Back of a length, on middle. Elgar works it to mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery outside off. Elgar lets it go this time.
Ohh..lovely use of the angle from Bumrah! A good-length delivery around off. Dean Elgar pushes forward to defend but the ball seams away sharply to beat the outside edge of his blade.
A good-length delivery outside off and seaming away. Elgar leaves it alone.
Touch fuller, outside off, shaping away. Keegan Petersen shoulders arms to  it. Top over from Mohammed Shami.
Keegan Petersen walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! LBW! Mohammed Shami gets the breakthrough! A good-length delivery on middle with that beautiful seam position. Aiden Markram looks to defend it but misses and gets rapped up on the pads. It looks dead straight as Indian players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Aiden Markram asks Dean Elgar whether to opt for the review or not but Elgar says not to take it because it looked dead plumb. Another failure for Aiden Markram and Shami is the man again for India. He draws first blood and Aiden Markram walks back to the pavilion disappointed.
A good-length delivery outside off. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Back of a length again, outside off. Aiden Markram rides the bounce and pushes it to covers this time.
Back of a length, on off. Aiden Markram solidly defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length on middle and leg. Elgar is hurried onto his shot and the ball hits him high on the pads. A leg bye is taken towards fine leg.
A good-length delivery outside off. Aiden Markram lets it go this time. Indian bowlers have not found much movement in these initial overs.
Drifting on the pads this time. Elgar clips it to mid-wicket and gets a single.
On a length, on middle. Elgar pushes this back to the bowler.
A length ball, on off. Aiden Markram pushes it past mid on this time and the batters run three again. Good timing by Aiden Markram and also good running from this pair.
A good-length delivery outside off. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Ohhh...Just away from the bowler! A full ball, on middle. Elgar pushes it aerially just left of Bumrah. He tries to catch it but it goes away from him towards long off and the batters run three.
Back of a length and down the leg side this time. Aiden Markram looks to clip it but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Aiden Markram pushes this away from his body square on the off side.
FOUR! Nice shot from Aiden Markram. He picks the length quickly and dispatches it. Slightly shorter on off. Aiden Markram stays deep in his crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A good-length delivery outside off. Aiden Markram leaves it alone this time.
Back of a length on middle angling into the body this time. Elgar works it to mid-wicket for a single. He is off the mark now.
Shami goes 'round the wicket straightaway and bowls this fuller on middle. Elgar pushes it to mid on.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
On a good length but down the leg side. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
First runs for South Africa! Good-length ball, on leg. Dean Elgar looks to tuck but the ball goes off his pads to fine leg. The batters take a leg bye.
Back of a length and down the leg side this time. Elgar lets it go this time.
Back of a length, outside off and good bounce there for Bumrah. Elgar initially looks to pull but then lets it go.
A good-length delivery angling away from Elgar on off. Elgar leaves it alone.
Bumrah starts off with a length delivery on middle.  Elgar defends this onto the turf.
